description.value:
Though you lost almost everyone you knew, whether due to luck, skill, or twist of fate, you're the lone survivor of one of the Wild Hunt's forays into the Universe. Your experience changed you. Wild animals and beasts are reluctant to confront you, knowing you've survived a far more dangerous predator. You have become quite skilled at sensing danger and can cover your tracks and hide with a speed that's almost uncanny. Though you might have found some semblance of peace, you now never leave your home without a weapon. The dreadful baying of hunting horns haunts your dreams, and on bad days, the tiniest noise makes you jump. You're constantly looking over your shoulder, whether to toss salt or spot enemies. You might hope to evade the Wild Hunt forever, changing your name and relocating to remain anonymous. Or you could aspire to gain enough power so you can face them on even footing, perhaps even challenging those who hunted you.

Choose two attribute boosts. Each boost has to be to Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom.

You're trained in both the Stealth and Survival skills. You gain your choice of either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Terrain Expertise] or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Terrain Stalker] skill feat.
